key_points: Walton family sold $534M of Walmart stock, a notable insider disposition.
Trump price‑cut claim sparked speculative premarket buzz but lacks concrete policy impact.
Analysts continue to discuss digital profit growth (Walmart Connect) and drone delivery expansion as potential upside, though still speculative.
Unusually high call option buying indicates short‑term bullish trader positioning.
Despite some buy ratings, the stock faces pressure from large insider selling and mixed retail sentiment.
